questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : यदि किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में, आय के स्तर में वृद्धि (AY) होती है, तो यह उपभोग के स्तर (AC) में सदैव आनुपातिक रूप से वृद्धि कर देगी ।
कथन 2 : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) व सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) सदैव एक-दूसरे के बराबर होती हैं ।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: If in an economy the level of income increases (AY), it will always proportionately increase the level of consumption (AC).
Statement 2: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) and Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) are always equal to each other.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is false because consumption does not always increase proportionately with income; there is a minimum level of autonomous consumption. Statement 2 is false because MPC + MPS = 1, meaning they are equal only when both are 0.5, which is not always the case.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से सही समीकरण की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the correct equation from the following:

options.C: GNPMP = GDPMP + विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध साधन आय

options_english.C: GNPMP = GDPMP + Net Factor Income from Abroad

questions.solution: Option C is correct because GNP at market price is the sum of GDP at market price and net factor income from abroad (NFIA). Option A is incorrect as GDPMP = NNPFC + Depreciation + Net Indirect Taxes. Option B is incorrect as NNPFC = NDPFC + NFIA. Option D is incorrect because NNPFC = NDPMP - Depreciation + Net Factor Income from Abroad.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए- अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) । नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प चुनिए :
अभिकथन (A) : पूर्ण रोज़गार स्थिति से तात्पर्य अनैच्छिक बेरोज़गारी की अनुपस्थिति से है ।
कारण (R) : पूर्ण रोज़गार की स्थिति में, सभी इच्छुक व सक्षम व्यक्तियों को प्रचलित मज़दूरी दर पर रोज़गार प्राप्त होता है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative given below :
Assertion (A): Full employment situation refers to absence of involuntary unemployment.
Reason (R): Under full employment situation, all the willing and able bodied people get employment at the prevailing wage rate.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है ।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true. Full employment is defined as the situation where everyone who is willing and able to work at the prevailing wage rate finds a job, which means there is no involuntary unemployment. Thus, the reason correctly explains the assertion.

questions.text: "दिनांक 9 जून 2023 के, नेशनल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज (NSE) के आँकड़ों के अनुसार, एक माह की अवधि यानि, 9 मई 2023 - 9 जून 2023, में विदेशी संस्थागत निवेशकों (FII) द्वारा ₹ 309 करोड़ की शुद्ध बिक्री की गई थी ।" उपर्युक्त लेन-देन भारत के भुगतान संतुलन के _______ खाते के _______ पक्ष में दर्ज किया जाएगा ।
questions.text_english: "As per the National Stock Exchange (NSE) data, dated 9th June, 2023, there was a net selling off worth ₹309 crore by Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) over the period of one month i.e., 9th May, 2023- 9th June, 2023." The above mentioned transactions will be recorded on _______ account of Balance of Payments of India, _______ side.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए : पूंजी खाते के डेबिट पक्ष में)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: Foreign Institutional Investment (FII) refers to assets, so it is recorded in the Capital account. Since selling FII implies an outflow of financial assets from India, it is recorded on the debit side of the Capital account.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से मुद्रा आपूर्ति (M1) की असत्य विशेषता / विशेषताओं की पहचान कीजिए :
(i) इसे समय के एक बिंदु पर मापा जाता है ।
(ii) इसमें सरकार के पास रखे गए धन-भंडार को सम्मिलित नहीं किया जाता है ।
(iii) यह सदैव राष्ट्र के केन्द्रीय बैंक के पास रखी मुद्रा होती है ।
questions.text_english:
Identify the incorrect feature(s) of money supply (M1) from the following:
(i) It is measured at a point of time.
(ii) It does not include stock of money held by the government.
(iii) It is always the currency in the hands of the Central Bank of a nation.
questions.solution: Statement (iii) is incorrect. Money supply (M1) includes currency held by the public and demand deposits with commercial banks. It does not include currency held by the central bank or the government as they are the issuers of money, not the holders whose currency counts towards the money supply.

questions.text: कीन्स के अनुसार घरेलू क्षेत्र द्वारा किया गया कुल उपभोग व्यय _______ व _______ का संयोजन है ।
questions.text_english: Total consumption expenditure by households under Keynesian Economics is a combination of _______ and _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थानों को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blanks)
questions.solution: According to Keynesian theory, total consumption expenditure (C) is defined as C = C0 + bY, where C0 is autonomous consumption and bY is induced consumption, which depends on the level of income.

questions.text_english:
Find the missing figures and choose the correct alternative:
Round | Deposits | Loans (80%) | Reserve Ratio (20%)
I | 5000 | 4000 | ..(i)..
II | 4000 | ..(ii).. | 800
Total | ..(iii).. | ..(iv).. | 5000
questions.solution: The reserve ratio is 20%. For Round I, (i) = 20% of 5000 = 1000. For Round II, loans are 80% of 4000 = 3200, so (ii) = 3200. Total deposits = Initial Deposit * (1/LRR) = 5000 * (1/0.2) = 25000, so (iii) = 25000. Total loans = Total deposits - Total reserves = 25000 - 5000 = 20000, so (iv) = 20000.

questions.text: भुगतान संतुलन (BOP) में अधिशेष का तात्पर्य _______ की अधिकता से है।
questions.text_english: Surplus in Balance of Payments (BOP) refers to the excess of _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)

options.B: स्वायत्त प्राप्तियों पर चालू खाता भुगतान
options.C: पूँजी खाता भुगतान पर पूँजी खाता प्राप्तियों

options_english.B: Current Account payments over Autonomous receipts
options_english.C: Capital Account receipts over Capital Account payments

questions.solution: A surplus in the Balance of Payments occurs when autonomous receipts (foreign exchange inflows) exceed autonomous payments (foreign exchange outflows).

questions.text: किसी काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए मान लीजिए कि : C = 100 + 0.75Y; I0 = 400. निवेश गुणक (K) का मान _______ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose for a hypothetical economy: C = 100 + 0.75Y; I0 = 400. Value of Investment Multiplier (K) would be _______.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Investment multiplier K = 1 / (1 - MPC). Given C = 100 + 0.75Y, MPC = 0.75. Therefore, K = 1 / (1 - 0.75) = 1 / 0.25 = 4.

questions.text: मान लीजिए कि, एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था का व्यापार संतुलन ₹ 500 करोड़ का अनुकूल संतुलन दर्शाता है । माल निर्यात का मूल्य ₹ 1200 करोड़ व हस्तांतरण भुगतान ₹ 400 करोड़ है । वाणिज्य (Merchandise) आयात का मूल्य _______ करोड़ होगा ।
questions.text_english: Suppose, the Balance of Trade of an imaginary economy shows a favourable balance of 500 crore. The values of merchandise exports are 1200 crore and transfer payments are 400 crore. The value of merchandise imports would be _______ crore.
questions.instruction_line: (रिक्त स्थान को भरने के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए)
questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct alternative to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: Trade Balance = Exports - Imports. A favourable balance means a surplus. 500 = 1200 - Imports. Therefore, Imports = 1200 - 500 = 700 crore. Transfer payments are not part of the balance of trade.

questions.text:
(क) एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए नीचे दिए गए आँकड़ों के आधार पर, साधन लागत पर शुद्ध घरेलू उत्पाद (NDPFC) के मूल्य का अनुमान लगाइए :
(i) सकल घरेलू स्थायी पूँजी निर्माण: 200
(ii) निर्यात: 320
(iii) अंतिम सरकारी उपभोग व्यय: (-) 40
(iv) स्थायी पूँजी का उपभोग: 50
(v) अंतिम घरेलू उपभोग व्यय: 35
(vi) मालसूची निवेश (शुद्ध): 470
(vii) आयात: 60
(viii) शुद्ध अप्रत्यक्ष कर: 50
(ix) विदेशों से प्राप्त शुद्ध कारक आय: 20
questions.text_english:
(a) On the basis of the data given below for an imaginary economy, estimate the value of Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDPFC):
(i) Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation: 200
(ii) Exports: 320
(iii) Government Final Consumption Expenditure: (-) 40
(iv) Consumption of Fixed Capital: 50
(v) Household Final Consumption Expenditure: 35
(vi) Inventory Investment (Net): 470
(vii) Imports: 60
(viii) Net Indirect Taxes: 50
(ix) Net Factor Income from Abroad: 20

key_points: Formula: NDPFC = Household Final Consumption Exp + Government Final Consumption Exp + (Gross Domestic Fixed Capital Formation + Inventory Investment) - Consumption of Fixed Capital - Net Indirect Taxes

sub_questions.solution: Using the expenditure method to calculate GDPMP: GDPMP = Private Final Consumption Expenditure + Government Final Consumption Expenditure + Gross Domestic Capital Formation (Fixed + Inventory) + Net Exports. Here, GDPMP = 35 + (-40) + (200 + 470) + (320 - 60) = 35 - 40 + 670 + 260 = 925. Then, NDPFC = GDPMP - Consumption of Fixed Capital - Net Indirect Taxes = 925 - 50 - 50 = 825.

questions.solution: To calculate the Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDPFC), we use the expenditure method. Firstly, we determine the Gross Domestic Product at Market Price (GDPMP) by summing up household consumption, government consumption, gross fixed capital formation, inventory investment, and net exports. Substituting the given values, we get 35 - 40 + 200 + 470 + (320 - 60), which equals 925. Finally, we convert this to NDPFC by subtracting the consumption of fixed capital (depreciation) and the net indirect taxes from the GDPMP. Therefore, NDPFC = 925 - 50 - 50 = 825.

questions.text: स्थिर विनिमय दर प्रणाली तथा नम्य विनिमय दर प्रणाली के मध्य अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Distinguish between fixed exchange rate system and flexible exchange rate system.

key_points: Fixed system: Rate is determined/managed by the government.
Flexible system: Rate is determined by market demand and supply of foreign exchange.
Fixed system requires official reserves; flexible system does not.

questions.solution: In a fixed exchange rate system, the value of the domestic currency is officially fixed by the government or the central bank against other currencies. Adjustments are rare and require government intervention. In contrast, under a flexible exchange rate system, the exchange rate is determined solely by the market forces of demand for and supply of foreign currency without direct government interference. Consequently, in a flexible system, the rate fluctuates constantly based on market equilibrium, whereas in a fixed system, it remains stable.

questions.text: (क) निम्नलिखित तालिका को पूरा कीजिए । आय के ₹200 करोड़ के स्तर पर उपभोग फलन का निर्माण कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: (a) Complete the following table. Construct/Express the Consumption function at ₹200 crore level of income.

key_points: Income 0, Savings -30 => Consumption = 30.
Consumption function C = C0 + bY = 30 + 0.7Y.
Complete missing table values based on relationships.

questions.solution: At income 0, savings are -30, so autonomous consumption is 30. At income 200, APC is 0.85, so consumption is 170. Consumption function is C = C0 + MPC * Y. Since C = 170 when Y = 200 and C0 = 30, we have 170 = 30 + MPC * 200, so MPC = 0.7. The consumption function is C = 30 + 0.7Y. The remaining values in the table are calculated using this function: At Y=100, C=100, S=0; At Y=300, C=240, S=60.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को वैध तर्कों द्वारा प्रमाणित कीजिए :
(क) केन्द्रीय बैंक किसी अर्थव्यवस्था का एकमात्र मुद्रा जारीकर्ता प्राधिकरण है ।
(ख) मुद्रा विलंबित भुगतानों (Deferred Payments) के मानक के माप के रूप में कार्य करती है ।
questions.text_english:
Justify the following statements with valid arguments:
(a) The Central Bank is the sole currency issuing authority of an economy.
(b) Money serves as a measure of standard of deferred payments.

key_points: Central bank control ensures uniform currency and money supply management.
Deferred payments allow contracts, credit transactions, and future liability settlement.
Standardized money ensures value consistency over time.

questions.solution: The Central Bank acts as the sole currency issuing authority to maintain uniformity in the circulating currency, ensure public trust, and allow for efficient control of the money supply in the economy. Without this, multiple issuing authorities would lead to chaos and instability. Regarding deferred payments, money functions as a standard unit because it allows for contracts and agreements involving future settlements of debt. Since money has a relatively stable value over time and is widely accepted, it makes the process of credit-based transactions and settling future liabilities predictable and standardized, which is crucial for modern economic operations.
questions.topic: Functions of Money and Central Bank

questions.text:
दिनांक 8 जून 2023 के 'द ईकोनोमिक टाइम्स' से उद्धृत निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
"भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की दर निर्धारण समिति ने स्पष्ट रूप से बैंचमार्क ऋण दर को 6.5% पर अपरिवर्तित रखने का निर्णय लिया है । समिति ने समायोजन मौद्रिक नीति (Accommodating Monetary Policy) को वापस लेने पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करने के लिए मतदान किया है ।"
दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य समझ के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(क) उपर्युक्त गद्य में दर्शाए गए आर्थिक मुद्दे को पहचानिए व चर्चा कीजिए ।
(ख) यदि दर निर्धारण समिति ने उक्त दर में कमी की होती, तो मुद्रा आपूर्ति के संभावित परिणामों की चर्चा कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully from 'The Economic Times' dated 8th June, 2023:
"The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI's) rate setting panel unanimously decided to keep the benchmark lending rate unchanged at 6.5%. The committee voted to remain focused on the withdrawal of accommodating monetary policy."
On the basis of given text and common understanding, answer the following questions :
(a) Identify and discuss the economic issue indicated in the above text.
(b) Discuss the likely consequence on money supply if the rate setting panel would have decreased the said rate.

sub_questions.text: (क) उपर्युक्त गद्य में दर्शाए गए आर्थिक मुद्दे को पहचानिए व चर्चा कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Identify and discuss the economic issue indicated in the above text.

key_points: Issue: Repo Rate policy and inflation control.
Explanation: Keeping the rate unchanged suggests a cautious stance against inflation.

sub_questions.solution: The economic issue is the conduct of monetary policy by the RBI, specifically the decision to keep the repo rate unchanged to control inflation while balancing growth. An unchanged repo rate reflects a neutral or cautious monetary stance, aiming to prevent excess money supply from fuelling further price increases in the economy.

sub_questions.text: (ख) यदि दर निर्धारण समिति ने उक्त दर में कमी की होती, तो मुद्रा आपूर्ति के संभावित परिणामों की चर्चा कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Discuss the likely consequence on money supply if the rate setting panel would have decreased the said rate.

key_points: Result: Increase in money supply.
Process: Lower borrowing costs, increased credit expansion.

sub_questions.solution: If the repo rate had been decreased, the borrowing costs for commercial banks would have fallen. This, in turn, would have likely led to lower interest rates on loans for the public, encouraging more borrowing and investment. Consequently, this expansion in credit would have increased the money supply in the economy.

questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions.

questions.text:
(क) निम्नलिखित को राजस्व प्राप्तियों अथवा पूँजीगत प्राप्तियों में वर्गीकृत कीजिए । अपने उत्तर के पक्ष में वैध तर्क दीजिए :
(i) ऋण पर प्राप्त ब्याज ।
(ii) किसी सरकारी कम्पनी की बिक्री से विनिवेश प्राप्तियाँ ।
(iii) भारत में बालिका शिक्षा को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका (USA) सरकार द्वारा दी गई वित्तीय सहायता ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Classify the following as Revenue receipts or Capital receipts. Give valid arguments in support of your answer:
(i) Interest received on loan.
(ii) Disinvestment receipts from the sale of a government company.
(iii) Financial assistance by the Government of USA for promoting girl education in India.

key_points: Interest: Revenue receipt, it is a regular income that does not reduce assets or create liabilities.
Disinvestment: Capital receipt, it reduces assets (government equity).
Financial assistance: Revenue receipt, it is a grant/transfer that does not create liabilities or reduce assets.

questions.solution: Interest received on loans is classified as a revenue receipt because it is a regular income that does not lead to any reduction in government assets or creation of new liabilities. Disinvestment receipts from the sale of a government company are classified as capital receipts because such sales reduce the government's assets (its ownership stake in the company). Financial assistance received from the USA government is a revenue receipt as it is a form of grant or aid that does not create any future repayment liability for the government nor does it reduce any assets.

questions.text:
(क) एक द्वि-क्षेत्रक मॉडल में आय के चक्रीय प्रवाह की अवधारणा की संक्षेप में व्याख्या कीजिए ।
(ख) "मौद्रिक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) की तुलना में वास्तविक सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) किसी राष्ट्र की आर्थिक संवृद्धि का बेहतर संकेतक है ।" क्या आप दिए गए कथन से सहमत हैं ? किसी वैध काल्पनिक संख्यात्मक उदाहरण के साथ अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Discuss briefly the concept of circular flow of income in a two-sector model.
(b) "Real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a better indicator of economic growth of a nation as compared to the Nominal Gross Domestic Product (GDP)." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with a valid hypothetical numerical example.

key_points: Two sectors: Household and Firm.
Households provide factors of production to firms.
Firms provide goods/services to households.
Income flows as factor payments, expenditure flows back as payment for goods.

sub_questions.solution: In a two-sector model consisting of households and firms, income circulates continuously. Households provide factor services (land, labour, capital, entrepreneurship) to firms, and in return, firms make factor payments (rent, wages, interest, profit) to households. Households then spend this income on purchasing final goods and services produced by firms, thus completing the flow of money back to the firms.

key_points: Agree: Real GDP accounts for inflation by using base year prices.
Example: Nominal GDP shows increase due to price hike, but Real GDP shows actual output change.
Real GDP reflects actual growth.

sub_questions.solution: I agree that Real GDP is a better indicator of economic growth. Nominal GDP can rise merely due to price increases, even if actual output remains constant. For instance, if an economy produces 100 units in year 1 at price 10 (Nominal GDP 1000) and 100 units in year 2 at price 15 (Nominal GDP 1500), it looks like growth, but it is just inflation. Real GDP, calculated at base year prices, remains 1000 in both years, correctly showing zero economic growth.

questions.solution: The circular flow in a two-sector model describes the constant movement of money and goods between households and firms. Regarding GDP, Real GDP is the better indicator because it adjusts for changes in the general price level by using base year prices, ensuring that changes in GDP reflect changes in actual production rather than inflation. Nominal GDP is vulnerable to price fluctuations, which can misrepresent the actual economic progress of a nation.

Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Choose the correct alternative given below :

Reason (R): Private sector wasted huge amounts in obtaining licenses rather than on improving the product quality and international competitiveness.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are true. The permit license raj required businesses to obtain government approval for most decisions, which led to significant resources being spent on navigating bureaucracy instead of improving efficiency or competitiveness, thereby justifying the assertion.

questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Under the colonial rule, basic infrastructure (like railways, post and telegraph etc.) was developed.
Statement 2: The real motive behind the infrastructural development in India was to strengthen the British interests.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है ।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है ।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. The British developed infrastructure like railways primarily to move raw materials out of India and finished British goods into the Indian market efficiently, as well as to facilitate military troop movement, thereby serving their own economic and political interests.

(ii) To discourage improvement of marketing infrastructure for farmers.

questions.text_english: (a) "During the colonial period, the occupational structure showed lopsided movements." Do you agree with the given statement? Justify your answer with valid arguments.

key_points: Agree: Predominance of agriculture (around 85%).
Lack of industrial growth and limited services.
Structural imbalance hampered modernization.

questions.solution: Yes, I agree that the occupational structure was lopsided. During the colonial era, the vast majority of the Indian population (around 85%) was engaged in agriculture as their primary occupation. The industrial and service sectors were highly underdeveloped and provided minimal employment, resulting in an unbalanced structure that lacked diversity and modernization, keeping the economy largely backward and dependent on primary production.

questions.text_english:
"In India, National Education Policy 2020 has stressed a lot on in-service training of the teachers."
(i) Identify the source of Human Capital Formation (HCF) indicated in the aforesaid statement.
(ii) Elaborate the likely impacts of this source on the economic development of India.

key_points: Source: On-the-job training/education.
Impacts: Improved productivity, better teaching quality, human capital enhancement.
Long-term economic growth.

questions.solution: The source of Human Capital Formation (HCF) indicated is on-the-job training. Investing in teachers through regular training improves the quality of education provided to the workforce. Enhanced teacher quality leads to a more skilled, knowledgeable, and productive future workforce, which is a fundamental driver for economic development, technological adoption, and increased national productivity in the long run.

(ख) चीन की आर्थिक संवृद्धि पर विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र (SEZ) के प्रभावों की चर्चा कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) "United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs indicated that India has overtaken China as the world's most populous country in April 2023." Explain the consequences of the one-child policy adopted by China in the 1970s.
(b) Discuss the impacts of Special Economic Zones (SEZs) on the economic growth of China.

key_points: One-child policy: Population control, reduced birth rate, aging population issues, skewed gender ratio.
SEZ: Export-led growth, foreign investment attraction, technological transfer, regional development.

questions.solution: China's one-child policy, introduced in the 1970s, effectively slowed population growth and reduced the birth rate, but it resulted in significant demographic challenges, including an aging population and a skewed gender ratio due to son-preference. Regarding SEZs, these regions allowed China to attract massive foreign direct investment and integrate into the global market. They acted as laboratories for market-oriented policies, boosting exports, facilitating technology transfer, and drastically accelerating China’s overall economic growth.

(ii) श्रमिक-जनसंख्या अनुपात किसी राष्ट्र में रोज़गार की स्थिति का विश्लेषण करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक संकेतक है ।

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) In the recent past, the Government of India has taken crucial steps, like Jan-Dhan Yojana, for efficient allocation of financial resources.
(ii) Worker-population ratio is an indicator, used for analyzing the employment situation in a nation.
State and elaborate whether the following statements are true or false, with valid arguments:

key_points: Statement (i) is True: Financial inclusion connects the unbanked to formal systems, reducing leakages and helping target subsidies.
Statement (ii) is True: It measures the proportion of a country's population that is employed, essential for evaluating labor market health.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. (i) Jan-Dhan Yojana is true as it achieved massive financial inclusion, ensuring that direct benefit transfers reach the intended beneficiaries efficiently, reducing corruption and improving fund allocation. (ii) The worker-population ratio is a crucial indicator because it tells us the percentage of the total population that is actually engaged in productive work, thus reflecting the employment landscape and the economic dependency of a nation.

questions.text_english:
(a) State any two problems faced by farmers during the initial years of organic farming.
(b) "In the current situation, Information Technology plays a vital role in achieving food security in a nation like India." Justify the given statement.

key_points: Organic problems: Lower initial yields, lack of infrastructure/inputs, certification costs.
IT role: Weather forecasting, market information, disease monitoring, efficient distribution.

questions.solution: Initial problems in organic farming included lower yields compared to intensive chemical farming and the lack of proper market channels and infrastructure for organic produce. Regarding Information Technology, it enhances food security by providing farmers with real-time data on weather, crop diseases, and market prices. This helps optimize production, reduces post-harvest losses, and connects rural producers to urban markets efficiently, ensuring better availability and access to food.

questions.text: (क) (i) “भारत सरकार द्वारा उठाए गए उदारीकरण उपायों के अंतर्गत, औद्योगिक क्षेत्र का नियमन अत्यंत महत्त्वपूर्ण था ।” मान्य तर्कों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का खंडन अथवा समर्थन कीजिए । (ii) “हरित क्रांति के बाद भी 1990 के दशक तक भारत की 65 प्रतिशत जनसंख्या कृषि क्षेत्रक में लगी रही ।” वैध तर्कों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "Under the liberalisation measures taken by the Government of India, regulation of industrial sector was extremely crucial." Reject or support the given statement with valid arguments.
(ii) "Despite the implementation of Green Revolution, 65 per cent of India's population continued to be engaged in the agriculture sector till the 1990s." Justify the given statement with valid explanation.

key_points: i) Support: Liberalization meant removing unnecessary controls, not total de-regulation, but shifting to competition.
ii) Justify: Industrial sector couldn't absorb the rural labor force; structural transformation was slow.

questions.solution: (i) I support the idea that industrial regulation was critical; however, the liberalization measures focused on *re-regulation* rather than *de-regulation*. The goal was to remove redundant controls that hindered productivity while maintaining essential oversight to foster competition and curb monopoly power. (ii) Agriculture continued to engage 65 percent of the population despite the Green Revolution because the industrial sector's growth in India was not rapid enough to absorb the surplus labour from rural areas. The structural transformation—where people move from agriculture to higher-productivity industrial and service jobs—was significantly slow, keeping labor trapped in low-productivity agriculture.

On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions:
(a) State any two concerns owing to which the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) was established.
(b) Explain any two functions performed by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).
(c) Elaborate any two strategies to ensure sustainable development as adopted by India.

sub_questions.text: (क) ऐसे किन्हीं दो मुद्दों का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनके कारण केन्द्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) की स्थापना की गई थी ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) State any two concerns owing to which the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) was established.

key_points: Addressing major environmental concerns: water pollution and air pollution.

sub_questions.solution: The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) was primarily established to address the two major environmental concerns of water pollution and air pollution in India.

sub_questions.text: (ख) केन्द्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) द्वारा किए जाने वाले किन्हीं दो कार्यों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Explain any two functions performed by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

key_points: Monitoring and data collection for air/water pollution.
Setting standards for emissions and trade effluents.
Providing technical assistance to governments.

sub_questions.solution: Two key functions of the CPCB are collecting and disseminating technical information relating to air, water, and land pollution, and setting specific standards for sewage, industrial trade effluents, and gaseous emissions. Additionally, they provide technical assistance to governments in planning pollution control measures.

sub_questions.text: (ग) भारत द्वारा धारणीय विकास सुनिश्चित करने के लिए अपनाई गई किन्हीं दो रणनीतियों का वर्णन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (c) Elaborate any two strategies to ensure sustainable development as adopted by India.

key_points: Promotion of non-conventional energy (Solar/Wind).
Promotion of bio-composting and organic farming.
Use of CNG in public transport.
Mini-hydel plants.

sub_questions.solution: To ensure sustainable development, India has adopted several strategies. Two prominent ones are: (1) Promoting the use of non-conventional sources of energy, such as solar and wind power, to reduce dependence on fossil fuels. (2) Shifting towards organic farming and bio-composting, which restores soil fertility, prevents chemical pollution, and promotes long-term ecological balance in the agricultural sector.
